note: Problems found in the official NTA syllabus documents themselves (not extraction errors). Evidence is what a person can check in the PDF.

issues.evidence: Page 1 header of the official Tamil syllabus PDF.

issues.issue: The 12 non-English language papers publish the same English template as English (101): reading comprehension (factual, narrative, literary) and verbal ability. No language-specific topics are published.
issues.evidence: Pages 1-2 of each official language syllabus PDF.

issues.issue: The scanned body of the official Urdu syllabus is headed (in Urdu) 'Department of Urdu, Central University of Kashmir - syllabus for M.A. Urdu admission (2017 onwards)'. NTA appears to reuse a university's 2017 syllabus.
issues.evidence: Page 2 image of the official Urdu syllabus PDF.

issues.issue: Syllabus body is a scanned image in Nastaliq script (Kashmiri, Urdu). No reliable local OCR model exists; needs human transcription.

The official 2026 Law (LLM) syllabus cites legislation that has been replaced: Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 (replaced by the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 from 1 July 2024), Companies Act, 1956 (largely replaced by the Companies Act, 2013) and Juvenile Justice Act, 2000 (replaced by the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015). Keep the official text verbatim; learning content must address both the syllabus wording and current law.
issues.evidence: pdftotext of the official COQP14 PDF, Units on Company Law, Criminal Law II and Juvenile Justice.

issues.issue: The official 2026 Punjabi syllabus PDF was created on 2023-12-12 (Microsoft Word 2016), two years before the cycle; every other PG syllabus PDF was created in December 2025. Likely carried over from an earlier cycle.
Text typed in legacy non-Unicode fonts (Kruti Dev / old Gurmukhi): the PDF text layer holds Latin letters instead of Devanagari/Gurmukhi, so copying text from these PDFs gives garbage.
issues.evidence: e.g. ACQP23 page 2 text layer reads 'osnkUr n’kZu dk bfrgkl' for 'वेदान्त दर्शन का इतिहास'.
